#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modAdd(long long a, long long b) {
    long long v = a + b;
    return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
}

long long modSub(long long a, long long b) {
    long long v = a - b;
    return v < 0 ? v + MOD : v;
}

long long modMul(long long a, long long b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

long long modMulMany(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
    return modMul(modMul(a, b), c);
}

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = modMul(res, a);
        a = modMul(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

long long modInv(long long a) {
    return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
}

vector<long long> fact(1, 1);
vector<long long> invFact(1, 1);

long long factFunc(int n) {
    while ((int)fact.size() <= n) {
        fact.push_back(modMul(fact.back(), (int)fact.size()));
    }
    return fact[n];
}

long long fInvFunc(int n) {
    int lastKnown = (int)invFact.size() - 1;
    if (lastKnown < n) {
        long long fn = factFunc(n);
        long long invFn = modInv(fn);
        invFact.resize(n + 1);
        invFact[n] = invFn;
        for (int i = n - 1; i > lastKnown; --i) {
            invFact[i] = modMul(invFact[i + 1], i + 1);
        }
    }
    return invFact[n];
}

long long ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
    return modMulMany(factFunc(n), fInvFunc(r), fInvFunc(n - r));
}

long long smallInv(int n) {
    return modMul(fInvFunc(n), factFunc(n - 1));
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    fInvFunc(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = modMulMany(p, n - i, smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = modAdd(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long numPhases = modMul(m + k, smallInv(k));
        long long term = modMulMany(ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = modAdd(answer, term);
        else
            answer = modSub(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
